headline: Mexico Restarts Avocado Harvest and Exports Following Price Standoff
summary: Mexico resumed avocado harvesting and exports after a three-week standoff over pricing in Michoacán, its primary growing state.
why: Michoacán is a global powerhouse for avocado production, and export disruptions directly tighten international supplies and elevate wholesale prices for agricultural importers and retailers.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Restarting exports increases supply volume flowing into international markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
